info.adoration: Adoration Room (Mount Tabor) open daily 7am-11pm; closed on public holidays.
info.confession: Fridays 4pm-6pm and Saturdays 10am-12pm; otherwise by appointment with the Parish Office. There is currently no Confession before Mass.
info.office_hours: Mon-Fri 9.30am-6.30pm; Sat-Sun 8.30am-1pm; closed on public holidays.
good_to_know: Main gate and back gate are open daily 5am-11pm, and close on public holidays after the 9am Mass.
From 2 to 11 Nov a boom lift is stationed at the open car park outside Little Shepherds' Schoolhouse, so some parking spaces, including handicap lots, are temporarily unavailable.
St Jerome Library is open Sundays 8am-1pm and 4pm-5.30pm.

events.title: Sunday Fellowship breakfast
events.text: The Biblical Apostolate Team serves breakfast at JPII Hall after the Sunday Masses. All are welcome; love offerings are welcome.

events.title: Charismatic Growth Series: Spiritual Warfare
events.text: Session by Fr Karolus Huar at the Hosea Room, Parish Centre Level 2. All are welcome.

events.title: Count It All Joy — talk by Dr Mary Healy
events.text: Archdiocesan Biblical Apostolate talk, 7.45pm-9.45pm at the Church of St Mary of the Angels. Register at bit.ly/2026CountItAllJoy.

events.title: Potluck fellowship after every Triduum Mass
events.text: Bring a dish portioned for 4 to share; drop off by 7.30pm at JPII Hall.

events.title: Feast Day celebration at JPII Hall
events.text: Dinner after the 5.30pm Feast Day Mass on Sat 28 Nov; on Sun 29 Nov breakfast after the 7am and 9am Masses and lunch after the 11am Mass.

events.title: 2027 Catechism registration closes
events.text: Register children born in 2020-2021 for the K2 and L1 sessions on myCatholicSG and upload the Baptism certificate. Sessions are Sundays 3pm-4.30pm; parents are expected to be present as catechists.

events.title: Encounter — Day of Prayer
events.text: A day of quiet to encounter God in Scripture and daily life, 9am-4.30pm at San Damiano Franciscan Centre. $80 per person; register at tinyurl.com/epjan27.
